title: Why a $28.7 Billion Buyback Did Not Move US Chip Stocks
description:
https://www.signumhq.com

SK Hynix announced a 40 trillion won buyback and cancellation — about 28.7 billion dollars, the largest treasury-share cancellation by a listed Korean company. Hynix closed up 12.73%. The Kospi closed up 5.89%.

US memory did not follow. In premarket at 7:21 ET: Micron -0.06%, SanDisk +0.23%, Western Digital +0.34%, Nvidia +0.39%.

So we counted. Since 2021 there have been 73 days where Korea exposure jumped 3% or more. Micron was higher the next day 44% of the time — against 52% on any given day. That gap is inside what chance produces at this sample size.

Our read: a buyback is a capital return, not a chip demand signal. There is no measured edge in chasing it.
